integrity: The attached symbolic checker and the analytic proof describe the same single theorem; no independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for time-homogeneous primitive doubly stochastic 3x3 matrices with the minimum five positive entries. The optimized quantity is asymptotic second-largest eigenvalue modulus, not finite-horizon total variation or mixing time. The optimal transition is defective and may have polynomial transient loss; historical priority beyond inspected sources remains unverified.
title: Sharp mixing on the sparsest primitive three-state bistochastic supports
